full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff's case in short, is that the suit land comprising an area of 3.14 acres of land belonged to plaintiff's brother Jadab who died 20 years ago leaving behind his widow Jatri, an unmarried daughter Shubhadra was inherited by his Widow Jatri for lifetime and this land  were managed by the plaintiff on behalf of the Jatri who gave the usufructs thereof to her who died in 1360 B.S. the plaintiff inherited the said land as reversionary Subhadra, the daughter of Jatri in. the meantime was married. But she was also sonless Subhadra obtained a patta with respect to the suit land from her mother. The patta is a collusive document and without consideration and there was no legal necessity for Jatri to transfer the same to Shubhadra. As the same patta has clouded the title of the Plaintiff, the plaintiff has been compelled to file this suit. Defendant contested the Suit by filing a written statement. The defdt's ease is that the patta was executed by Jatri in favour of Subhadra for legal . necessity and for a consideration of Tk. 900/- and the defdt is in possession of the suit land from the date of execution of the patta as such the plaintiff is not entitled to any decree. The learned, Munsif decreed the suit.
